verses.1: I longed that Jehovah would hear my voice when I cried out to Him.
verses.2: For he listened to me, and in my days I will speak.
verses.3: My bonds of death and my enemies found me in distress. They will bring me harm and suffering.
verses.4: And in the name of Jehovah, I will cry out, “Yahweh, save my soul!”
verses.5: May Jehovah be blessed, and may our God be praised.
verses.6: May Jehovah protect me from harm, and may He save me.
verses.7: May my soul return to its resting place, as Jehovah has promised.
verses.8: For you have rescued my soul from death, my eyes from pain, and my feet from the ground.
verses.9: You shall walk in the land of Jehovah in those living nations.
verses.10: I believed that I would speak. I answered many questions.
verses.11: I said in a hurry, “All people are thieves.”
verses.12: What can I say to Jehovah about all his commands?
verses.13: I will call upon the name of Jehovah.
verses.14: I give this as a vow to the LORD. May it be rejected by all nations.
verses.15: Worthy in the eyes of Jehovah, who has died for His saints.
verses.16: I am Your servant, O LORD! I serve You truly, as Your true child. You have opened the doors for me to enter into Your service.
verses.17: I will offer sacrifices to God, and in the name of Jehovah I will call upon Him.
verses.18: I swear by the Lord, I will surely do this against all nations.
verses.19: In the courtyards of the Temple in Jerusalem, in its inner chambers.
